profile.headline: Software Engineer at TikTok | Ex-Shopify, Ex-Flexport | USC Alumni
profile.summary:
Hey! I am a passionate coder always updated with modern tech stack. I enjoy solving problems encountered during the software development process.

I have 3 years of experience working at global e-commerce brands like Shopify and Flexport. During this time, I've worked on several full-stack applications in the MERN stack, gaining hands-on experience with JavaScript, and RESTful APIs, and understanding how scalable applications are built in the tech industry.

Technology Stack:
Languages: Python, Typescript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, PHP, SQL, C, C++, Java, C#
Frameworks: React.js, Django, Node.js, Apache Spark, Angularjs, Flask
Database: MongoDB, Oracle MySQL, PostGres
Cloud: AWS

Feel free to contact me to discuss how I can contribute to your company at ayushcpatel87@gmail.com.

• Devised an Android and IOS application for users to provide an easy ordering system at the restaurant (Using Xamarin – C# and .Net).

projects.title: Binary Diary
projects.description:
Build a full-stack social networking app in MERN. Use Stateless JWT (JSON Web Tokens) authentication practices. Use Redux with chrome dev tools for state management.
React Hooks, Bcrypt Password hashing, Async/Await & modern practices.
Create an extensive backend API with Express and tested with Postman HTTP Client tool.

projects.title: Live World News Portal
projects.description:
Created a News portal with search functionality, Live World-Cloud using Google news API.
Implemented this project using a dynamic approach in JavaScript, HTML, CSS for Front-end. Back-end was implemented on cloud in AWS using Python language and Flask Framework.
